title: Monitor and inspect
simpleAction: The model rates this plant's recent readings as stressed, but no single sensor condition explains it. Keep monitoring and inspect the plant and sensors in person.
reason: Predicted class is 'moderate' without a persistent out-of-range sensor condition under the configured ranges. Model P(moderate)=0.96. Priority raised to high: the model has rated the last 3 consecutive readings 'moderate' or higher.
scientificContext: The model gives a statistical estimate learned from a synthetic dataset and has not been validated on real plants. When it is unsure, or no single sensor explains a stress rating, inspecting the plant and sensors in person is the most reliable check.

title: Check watering
simpleAction: Soil moisture has stayed low for several readings. Check the soil moisture and your watering schedule.
reason: Last 3 soil readings are below the configured monitoring level (25.0%). Soil moisture 2.5 % (recent average 2.1 %); model P(high)=0.57.
scientificContext: Tulsi (Ocimum) generally prefers evenly moist, well-drained soil; prolonged dryness and waterlogging both stress the roots. A soil-moisture sensor gives a relative reading that depends on the soil, pot and probe placement, so confirm by checking the soil by hand.
